purpose: Test whether the free ~12 kHz effective readout pole can be replaced by the documented Magnicon XXF-1 Connector Box anti-alias filter without materially degrading the line-robust 1-200 kHz continuum fit.

manual_reference.location: Connector Box / Anti-alias filter, manual pp. 45-48
manual_reference.documented_filter: three output-channel filters, second-order Bessel type, cutoff 10 kHz +/-2.5%
manual_reference.state_control: Connector Box top switch or DB-15 pin 12 LPF; LED indicates actual on/off state
manual_reference.measurement_time_state: unknown; this diagnostic tests the LPF-ON hypothesis only

magnicon_filter.normalization_guardrail: The manual states a 10 kHz cutoff but does not state the exact analog-Bessel normalization. 'mag' interprets 10 kHz as the -3 dB cutoff; 'phase' is included as a convention-sensitivity check.

guardrail: A successful replacement supports consistency with the documented XXF-1 10 kHz output LPF, but does not prove that the filter was ON during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition. Confirm the Connector Box LED/switch or historical wiring separately. No production model or data are changed by this diagnostic.
